    The explicit bound n ≤ max(30, 4 dim A) (Corollary 1.1) #

    Let B be the minimal representation-infinite quotient of the basic corner of A, and d = dim B ≤ dim A. The nilpotence bound of the embedding data is

    • dim of a quotient of B in the nondistributive case (SplitBasicData.exists_embeddingData_le);
    • the number of points of the band cycle in the walk case: a window of 3d arrows of a line of the cover contains a good pair (WLine.exists_goodPair_window), and the band of a good pair needs no condition on contours (exists_lineBandRel), so the cycle has fewer than 3d points;
    • the number of points of a critical piece C in the covering case.

    In the covering case, the Kronecker pair of a critical piece lives on the minimal set T' of points whose quotient has unbounded indecomposables, so n ≤ |T'|. If |T'| ≥ 30, the Euler form of that quotient is critical of type D̃ and its long induced path gives a module line with |T'| - 3 arrows (pointBrickAt_critical_line). If that line has 3d arrows we use its band instead; otherwise |T'| + 1 ≤ 3d + 3 ≤ max(30, 4d).

    Module.finrank k B = Nat.card { μ : (x : P) × (y : P) × (x ⟶ y) // μ.snd.snd ≠ 0 }
